fields.quote: I have the design output. I will commit it to main somewhere and push it.
fields.statement: Claude Design's output is on main (commit 1f4b22c, 'Add the Rhiza Monitor design system') in internal/web: static/css/rhiza-tokens.css and rhiza.css (tokens and components), static/fonts (Instrument Sans, JetBrains Mono, Petrona, with their OFL licences), static/icons, site.webmanifest, the live-update script, and static reference pages with sample data in pages/ (overview, runs, run, roadmap, change-set); internal/web/README.md describes it. The daemon serves static/ through go:embed from internal/web, and the page change sets build from these reference pages
